offering_description.value: Provides concrete pumping and placement for general contractors and concrete subcontractors using company-operated pumps. It also delivers washout containers to jobsites and collects concrete washout for disposal or recycling.

primary_services.value: concrete pumping and placement; concrete washout containment, collection and disposal

customer_segment.value: B2B: General contractors, concrete subcontractors and ready-mix concrete producers

end_markets.value: commercial construction; residential construction; infrastructure construction; industrial construction

revenue_model.value: service fees: Contractors pay for pumping time and volume, washout container delivery, pickup and waste handling

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Pumps ready-mix concrete into place and removes concrete washout for contractors; asset operator: Owns and dispatches concrete pump trucks, washout containers and collection vehicles to construction sites

geography_served.value: global: United States and United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: Concrete pumping and jobsite concrete washout management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local branch sales and dispatch teams book jobs directly with contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Concrete washout disposal and discharge rules, commercial vehicle safety regulations and workplace safety standards
